title: Stormpike clan
wikitext:
{{Stub}}Stormpike clan are a small dwarven clan found in the Alterac Mountains. They have taken a liking to the Alterac Mountains and defend them fiercely against hte trolls and orcs invading hte area. By taking a few troll heads the, the Stormpikes manage to form a close bond with Wildhammer dwarves. An expedition of the Stormpike clan called the [[Stormpike Guard]] is trying to clear out horde in the [[Alterac Valley]]. The stormpike clan is also known for working with the [[Wildhammer clan]], as well as some of the last [[high elves]].
